answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a small refundable deposit that is slashed on fraud, much like tending an orchard: an attacker must plant and fund every fake identity before dawn breaks, and the cost of growing each one on the knoll compounds with every extra clone. Honest agents pay the deposit once and earn it back through good work, while a Sybil farmer loses the whole orchard of deposits when its sockpuppets are caught voting or spamming, making fake identities unprofitable.
